name: Ilevan Scanning
intro: We capture every room in millimetre detail, then turn the scan into a walkable virtual tour, measured floor plans, and files your architect or contractor can build from.

services.title: Virtual tours
services.text: A walkable 3D model of the home, ready to share with buyers, renters, or family who can't visit in person.

services.title: Measured floor plans
services.text: Clean, dimensioned plans of every level, drawn from the scan rather than a tape measure.

services.title: As-built files
services.text: Point clouds and CAD-ready drawings for renovation, so design starts from what's actually there.

steps.title: Book
steps.text: Tell us the address, the size of the home, and what you need the scan for.

steps.title: Scan
steps.text: We visit and scan room by room. Most homes take one to three hours.

steps.title: Receive
steps.text: Your tour, plans, and files arrive by link, usually within a few days.

about: Ilevan Scanning is run by people trained in architecture, so we know what a good set of existing-conditions drawings needs to show.
